items.title: 17.10 RC series circuit se AC (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of AC through an RC series circuit (PDF 99-100).

blocks.text: Resistance R aur capacitor C AC source V se series mein jure hain (Fig 17.9 a). Dono se aik hi current guzarta hai. R par voltage VR = Irms R hai, current ke saath in phase; C par voltage VC = Irms XC = Irms / (wC), current se 90 darje peeche. Current ko hawala le kar VR current ki lakeer ke saath aur VC us ke amudan banaya jata hai (Fig 17.9 b). Lagaya voltage vector jor hai: Vrms = (VR^2 + VC^2) ka square root = Irms x (R^2 + (1/wC)^2) ka square root. Is liye impedance Z = Vrms / Irms = (R^2 + (1/wC)^2) ka square root (17.21).

Yeh impedance diagram (Fig 17.9 c) R ko hawala simt mein aur XC ko amudan dikhata hai; Z un ka vector jor hai. Z aur R ke darmiyan zawiya theta voltage aur current ka phase farq hai: yahan current voltage se theta aage hai (Fig 17.9 d), jahan theta = tan^-1(XC/R) = tan^-1(1/(wCR)) = tan^-1(1/(2 pi f C R)).

RC series circuit mein kharch taqat resistor ki wajah se hai, kyunke capacitor sirf tawanai jama karta aur zaya nahi karta: P = I^2 R, ya P = VI cos(theta) (17.22), jahan theta voltage aur current ka phase zawiya hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: RC series circuit (AC source ke saath R aur C series mein) aur us ki voltage tikon: current ke saath VR = IR, us ke neeche amudan VC = IXC, aur nateeja V = IZ; Z = sqrt(R^2 + (1/wC)^2), tan(theta) = XC/R. Daen: RL series circuit aur us ki tikon jis mein VL = IXL, VR ke oopar amudan; Z = sqrt(R^2 + (wL)^2), tan(theta) = wL/R.
blocks.caption: RC aur RL series circuits aur un ki voltage tikonein (Figs 17.9 aur 17.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Resistor ka voltage current ke saath hum-qadam; capacitor ka chauthai chakkar peeche aur inductor ka chauthai chakkar aage. Pythagoras kul voltage aur zawiya phase farq deta hai.

blocks.text: 5 kilo-ohm resistor 5 uF capacitor ke saath series mein 220 V, 50 Hz AC source par jura hai. Phase zawiya maloom karein. Hal: theta = tan^-1(1/(2 pi f C R)) = tan^-1[1/(2 x 3.14 x 50 Hz x 5 x 10^-6 F x 5000 ohm)] = tan^-1(0.1273) = 7.25 darje.

blocks.prompt: Misal 17.6 mein impedance aur rms current maloom karein.

items: Current voltage se theta = tan^-1(1/(wCR)) aage.
Taqat sirf R mein: P = I^2 R = VI cos(theta).
